stories.title: Symbiont spatial organisation is dynamically regulated within cnidarian host tissues
stories.body: The symbiosis with photosynthetic dinoflagellate algae enables corals to build and sustain reef ecosystems. Individual coral polyps hold algal symbionts in their epithelial endoderm cells and lose them under environmental stress, leading to coral bleaching.
